subject.title: [Feature]: Inline agent widgets in web chat via client-capability-gated tools

question: Should OpenClaw accept `requiredClientCaps` as a plugin-visible tool API and ship a Canvas-owned `show_widget` surface for model-authored SVG/HTML in web chat?
rationale: This combines a durable plugin/gateway API with a scripted markup sandbox boundary, so source inspection can show the implementation shape but cannot approve the product and security policy.

options.title: Review The Linked Implementation
options.body: Use the open implementation PR as the candidate path, fixing its blockers and explicitly accepting the API and sandbox boundary before merge.

options.title: Redesign The Capability API First
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause the implementation until maintainers choose a narrower or different client-capability contract.

options.title: Reject Bundled Widget Support
options.body: Close the implementation path and route widget experimentation to external plugins or ClawHub until a missing core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Review The Linked Implementation
recommendation.body: Use the open implementation PR as the candidate path, fixing its blockers and explicitly accepting the API and sandbox boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored both this feature request and the active implementation candidate, and is the clearest owner for the API/product/security direction choice.
